documents.topic: Empirical investigation of the cost curve of per-type SwiftPM target decomposition for swift-standard-library-extensions: fixed overhead vs incremental-locality + parallelism benefits. Scopes the research question, enumerates options, surveys theoretical bounds, and hands off to the experiment for measurement. N=1 clean-build baseline 1.37s; N=77 clean-build 3.88s; ratio 2.83× (mid-band of predicted 1.5–4×).
documents.statusDetail: Self-containment refactor + @inlinable sweep complete; ratio settled mid-band. Backing experiment at Experiments/modularization-compile-time/. Frontmatter version 1.2.0 trailing latest changelog entry 1.3.0 — minor drift.
